listing.name: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six 3 (Xbox) — Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six 3 (Xbox) — static recompilation (phobos665)
listing.summary: macOS boot through movies/menus and online play are reported; widescreen is unchecked. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Provide your own Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six 3 (Original Xbox) Original Xbox complete extracted game files, including the original executable. Title 55530013; Insignia needs own-console backup and TU 0x501.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Place DirectXbox-Recomp beside the checkout and run scripts/build.py with your own disc files. Insignia also requires a backup from your own console.

warnings: macOS boot through movies/menus and online play are reported; widescreen is unchecked.
